$comment: VAPP-189 (S1, docs/package-format.md "Records"): THE records query, one evaluator on every host. TS reference src/host/query.ts (`@exponential_app/eui/host/query`), Rust twin eui-core `host/query.rs`, reached by the Swift and Compose SDKs over the FFI (`parse_records_query_json`, `parse_records_source_json`, `records_value_json`); every one replays these cases. Inputs hand-written, `expected` filled by scripts/generate-host.ts. PARSE (`parseCases`: parseRecordsQuery(params, kind?)): query params (as parseSource gives them) → the structured query {from, app, mine, user, where: [{field, op, value}], sort: [{field, order}], limit, sum, month: {field, key} | null}. `kind` = the source's own name (`records:<kind>`), which wins over a `kind` param; `from` = the kind (none = null); `app=<slug>` = another app's rows (the HOST resolves whose); `mine=1|true` = the viewer's rows; `user=<id>`; `sort` (default `query.sortDefault`) + `order=asc|desc` (default `orderDefault`, anything else = the default) = the one sort key of the URL sugar; `limit` a positive integer (default `limitDefault`, capped at `limitMax`); `sum=<field>`; `by=<dateField>` (+ `month=YYYY-MM`, a malformed one = null = the month of now) = the month view, `month` without `by` = none; every OTHER key (the `reserved` keys never; an empty key never) = a condition: `<field>=v` eq, `<field>.gt|gte|lt|lte=v` (a different suffix = an eq on the whole key), sorted by field then operator. The JSON query form (VAPP-190) adds keys next to these. SOURCES (`sourceCases`: parseRecordsSource(parseSource(source))): `records:<kind>?q` = parse(q, kind); any other scheme = null (a host's own spelling, Exponential's `exp:records?kind=<kind>&q`, hands its params to parse). VALUE (`valueCases`: recordsValue(rows, parse(params, kind), {me, now, names})): null without a kind; else the rows of that kind where: the AUTHOR (`authorId ?? createdBy`, #VAPP-187: an owner's on-behalf write is its author's) is `me` for `mine` (signed out = nothing) and `user` for `user=`; with a month view the `field` text starts with the month key; every condition holds over the field (the row keys `id`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `createdBy` read the row, `authorId` the author, any other name the data): eq compares as text (null/missing = "", objects as JSON), the ranges as numbers when both sides parse (finite), else as text by UTF-16 code units. Sorted by each sort key (desc reverses), ties by id; {rows: [{…data, id, createdAt, updatedAt, createdBy, authorId (the author), author}] cut at the limit (a data key never shadows a row key; `author` = names[author] or ""), count: the matches before the limit, sum?: Σ of the field's numbers over the matches (non-numbers count 0, rounded to 1e-6), month?: {key, label (`months`), prev, next, today (now's date), days: every day of the month {date, day, weekday (`weekdays`), count, sum}, labels/counts/sums: the same days as chart-ready arrays}}. The `rowKeys` ride on every row and are reserved: a kind's schema may not declare them.
